avis.texte: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! I’m in my late 30’s and out of nowhere I broke out in bad hives and acne all over my face and it wouldn’t go away! I did a lot of research and decided to try this and omg let me tell you! Very soft and light and leaves my skin very bright and hydrated I wear no face makeup anymore and people compliment my skin often! The breakouts are almost completely gone after not even a month and the scars from the big ones are fading away! BUY THIS! I will be making this my regular moisturizer from now on!

avis.titre: Lightweight, Hydrating, and Perfect for Acne-Prone Skin
avis.texte: This moisturizer has become a staple in my skincare routine. It’s incredibly lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated without any greasy or heavy feeling. I have acne-prone skin, so I was nervous about trying a new moisturizer, but this one doesn’t clog my pores or make me break out. In fact, it pairs perfectly with the Curology Gentle Cleanser and has really helped keep my skin balanced. My face feels moisturized all day without looking oily. A little goes a long way, and the pump dispenser makes it easy to use just the right amount. If you’re using the Curology cleanser, I highly recommend getting this moisturizer too, they make a great combination. I’ve tried a lot of moisturizers over the years, and this is one I’ll definitely keep repurchasing!

avis.titre: Has helped my skin and is really nice!Has helped my skin and is really nice!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the gel, moisturizer, and gentle cleanser together for a little while now, and overall I’m really happy with the set. The cleanser is super gentle and doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight or dry, which is a big plus for me. It feels like it actually cleans without stripping everything away. The gel and moisturizer both have a really nice, lightweight feel. They absorb quickly and don’t leave any greasy or heavy residue, so they layer well and work great for everyday use. My skin has been feeling softer and more balanced since I started using them. If I had to point out anything, it’s that the moisturizer might not be quite enough on its own if you have very dry skin, but for normal to slightly dry skin it works really well. Overall, a solid routine—simple, gentle, and effective. I’d definitely keep using these.

avis.titre: Best moisturizer for oily and dry skin
avis.texte: Best moisturizer I have ever used! Sinks into skin, and because it’s a gel it doesn’t leave a greasy layer on top of skin. My face feels perfectly soft and my makeup goes on flawlessly!
This is my favorite lightweight face lotion. It feels so hydrating when it goes on but not greasy. I also love that it doesn’t have a strong smell.
My 80 year old skin really likes this cream. It’s not greasy, spreads smoothly, takes the stiffness away. Very nice product for the face.

I love this moisturizer more than anything, any moisturizer I've used after this just didn't feel as good. It's light, texture is amazing, cold, helped with my acne, and was easy to apply. I get a very long use out of these bottles, day and night! I've been using this for almost three years now!
Looove this brand. Not greasy or pore clogging! This is my 5th bottle!

avis.titre: it rubs the lotion on its skin or it gets the hose again
avis.texte: I’ve been using this moisturizer for six months after I kept having dry skin on my face and it’s been working very well for me. I don’t use face wash everyday but for some reason my face kept getting dry and this moisturizer really does the work for me.
I use this daily and really love it. It’s super soft and gentle on my skin but still leaves my face feeling clean. The foam is light and satisfying without feeling harsh or drying.

This is definitely a terrific product. Nice and lightweight. Works wonders for your skin. Doesn’t clog your pores or cause breakouts. I will be getting this on a regular basis. I highly recommend this product.

I don’t like when my face feels greasy which is why I avoid putting on sunscreen under makeup which I know you’re not supposed to do, anyway this moisturizer is amazing I have combination skin but lately it’s been dry due to my pregnancy and this moisturizer has left my skin soft and moisturized without feeling greasy or it feeling thick. I used to have the entire curology subscription but I really only used the moisturizer, I’m glad you can buy it separately. This stuff is amazing and I love using it to prep my skin before makeup ! Does not leave you feeling sticky

Every single daily moisturizer i have bought leaves me with hives after just two seconds on my skin, this does not it absorbs right away and is gel so it isn't greasy and heavy, it's perfect! I can use it under makeup that typically cakes and dries out also so this is perfect!

I absolutely live by this face wash and moisturizer. It is light weight, moisturizing and doesn’t leave a greasy residue. This high quality moisturizer is perfect for daily use. I haven’t missed a day in over two years.

avis.titre: True gel consistency, applied well onto my skin
avis.texte: This is a true gel consistency and was easy to spread onto my face and neck. Sometimes I feel like gel formulas don’t soak into my skin as well as moisturizers do, but I felt like this one provided me with moisture and didn’t just sit on top of my skin! It was lightweight so best for morning application. At night is when I’d want thicker. Has a pump top so it’s easy to dispense, but when you get to the bottom you’ll need to probably open it up to get all of the product out. Overall enjoyed the formula and it worked great for morning use under makeup.

I have very dry skin due to using a retinoid and being older. I usually use very rich moisturizers but I was interested in trying this Curology gel because I've heard good things about it. The gel is lightweight but it actually really does a good job hydrating. I wouldn't be able to use just this at night but it's a great day cream for me. There's no scent and it absorbs quite quickly on my face. It almost feels like a silky serum. My face doesn't sting when I use it which is an issue for me because it is sensitive due to the Retin-A. I have used this gel about six times and have had no issues with it and it kept my face hydrated during the day. It's quite affordable as well which is always a plus these days. I think it would work really well on people with normal or combination skin.

At first glance, this looks like a very nice gel face moisturizer. It is very lighweight and has absolutely no odor. It is a white, creamy lotion that rubs on clear and then totally disappears into your skin. I must say that it leaves your skin very, very soft. I have one dark spot and some rosacea that I am hoping will go away after using this lotion. I put some on my hand and it was very quick to absorb and left my hand feeling very soft and nice.

This moisturizer is lightweight and really feels nice on your skin. It’s a clear gel with a little bit of scent. Just a pump or two is all you need to really make your skin feel great. I really love that this brand is dermatologist founded and developed so you can feel good about using it on your skin.

The moisturizer pumps out smoothly. It absorbs quickly and very lightweight. My face feels soft and smooth. Also love the size of the bottle; it does not take up much space and perfect for carryon when traveling.
This moisturizer is a nice gel consistency. It’s definitely not too thick, but is thicker than a lotion. It has seeming no scent at all. The pump works well and distributes a small amount at a time.
